description: This file defines the class Image_Graph_Dataset_Trivial, a dataset class for handling points (x, y) in a graph, including methods for adding points, retrieving first/last points, and iterating over the dataset.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Dataset_Trivial
classes.description: A dataset class for storing and manipulating (x, y) points in a graph.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Dataset_Trivial
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dataset with optional array of points.

methods.name: addPoint
methods.description: Adds a point (x, y) with optional ID to the dataset.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first point in the dataset.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns the last point in the dataset.

methods.name: _getPointX
methods.description: Retrieves the X value of a point at a given index.

methods.name: _getPointY
methods.description: Retrieves the Y value of a point at a given index.

methods.name: _getPointID
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a point at a given index.

methods.name: _getPointData
methods.description: Retrieves additional data associated with a point at a given index.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of points in the dataset.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets internal iteration pointer to the start.

methods.name: _next
methods.description: Returns the next point in iteration and advances the pointer.
